newsitem.title: USA: Reliance, MTS, Lambert in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Reliance, MTS, Lambert in joint venture.

text.p: Lambert Fenchurch Group Plc said Friday its U.S subsidiary has agreed with Reliance Insurance Co and MTS Insurance Services to form a joint venture in the U.S. known as New Century Global Inc.

With an initial capitalization of $9.5 million, New Century, said the company, will operate as a specialist insurance broker and managing general agent, offering property and casualty products throughout the U.S.
Under the terms of the agreement, Lambert Fenchurch is acquiring a 40 percent stake in New Century for approximately $3.9 million.
The company said Reliance is also taking a 40 percent stake through a $3.9 million cash investment.

MTS, a limited liability insurance broker, which specialises in property and casualty business, will transfer 25 percent of its own shares and is contributing $299,000 in cash for the remaining 20 percent of New Century's equity.
